segments.speaker: Judge
segments.text: This is a fictional training hearing. All names and events are invented. We will distinguish observations, records and assumptions.

segments.speaker: Opposing counsel
segments.text: When did you first arrive at Cendana warehouse on 14 October 2026?

segments.speaker: Raka Pradana
segments.text: I first arrived at 21:30 WIB. I had not been at the site earlier that evening.

segments.speaker: Defense counsel
segments.text: Your earlier interview gives a different time. What did you use to estimate your arrival?

segments.speaker: Raka Pradana
segments.text: I may now be remembering a time on the camera display. In the earlier interview I said I had checked my phone. I cannot reconcile those memories today.

segments.speaker: Opposing counsel
segments.text: What did dispatch permit you to collect?

segments.speaker: Raka Pradana
segments.text: Maya authorized me to collect two cartons of tablets that evening.

segments.speaker: Defense counsel
segments.text: Did you open the cartons or receive a completed contents checklist?

segments.speaker: Raka Pradana
segments.text: I did not open either carton. I asked who had checked them, but I did not receive confirmation of their contents.

segments.speaker: Opposing counsel
segments.text: Was the gate continuously watched while you were there?

segments.speaker: Raka Pradana
segments.text: Dimas stayed at the gate the entire time. He never left for a patrol.

segments.speaker: Judge
segments.text: Dimas, describe only what you personally observed.

segments.speaker: Dimas Arya
segments.text: I left the gate for a perimeter inspection at about 20:20 and returned around 20:45. Near the bay I saw two brown cartons being moved, but I could not see inside them.

segments.speaker: Opposing counsel
segments.text: Do the CCTV and gate times prove there were two separate visits?

segments.speaker: Nila Sasmita
segments.text: Not by themselves. CAM-2 was 64 minutes fast. If that offset was stable, a display of 21:12 corresponds to about 20:08 WIB. The face in the described frame is obscured.

segments.speaker: Defense counsel
segments.text: Does card DR-17 conclusively identify the person at the gate?

segments.speaker: Sari Ananta
segments.text: The card was assigned to Raka. The reader recorded the credential, not a face or biometric identity.

segments.speaker: Opposing counsel
segments.text: How many tablets were missing, and when was that discovered?

segments.speaker: Bima Nusa
segments.text: The recorded counts were twenty tablets at 18:00 on 14 October and eight at 08:15 the next morning. The discrepancy is twelve tablets, discovered on 15 October.

segments.speaker: Defense counsel
segments.text: Can you establish that the twelve tablets were inside those two cartons?

segments.speaker: Bima Nusa
segments.text: No. The count difference does not tell me the carton contents, the exact time of movement, or who moved the tablets.

segments.speaker: Opposing counsel
segments.text: What happened at the returns desk?

segments.speaker: Raka Pradana
segments.text: The returns desk signed a receipt for both cartons at 09:00 on 15 October. I do not have that receipt with me.

segments.speaker: Defense counsel
segments.text: Was it raining that evening?

segments.speaker: Raka Pradana
segments.text: Yes. It was already raining before I arrived.

segments.speaker: Judge
segments.text: The receipt claim needs verification. The exercise does not establish guilt, intent, the contents of the cartons, or a legal conclusion.
